row.notes: myteam-g2: Rebuilds the cached stat values of a My Team attribute set: collects active stat records (0x78-byte, active flag at +0x70) from set+8..+0x10, drops released effect refs (+0x38..+0x40), re-sums effect contributions per stat id (8-byte id/float pairs, clamped via vmaxss/vminss), and runs the change callbacks (FUN_140c993c0). Called after contracts link/progress, i.e. sponsor and driver contract effects feed stats through here. Hook: after calling it, modified stat floats take effect. DISPUTE(V9017) role per verifier: Not a deterministic recompute. The object holds a seeded RNG (counter +0x98, seed words from +0xa8, state size 0x270): it filters candidate effect templates by requirements, then loops up to param_1+0x80 times picking a random candidate (rng modulo count), applying it via FUN_140c95990 and adding per-stat id/float pairs clamped to [-1,1], then fires callbacks FUN_140c993c0. Better role: random effect-roll/regenerate for a stat set; the +0x70 active flag, 0x78 stride and +0x38..0x40 ref release parts of the claim do exist.
